lines.say: [whispering, alarmed] Sarge! That Ork just paid for a buggy with his own teeth. Why?!
lines.text: SARGE! THAT ORK JUST PAID FOR A BUGGY WITH HIS OWN TEETH. WHY?!

lines.say: [deadpan] Teef, son. Ork money. And it grows back.
lines.text: TEEF, SON. ORK MONEY. AND IT GROWS BACK.

lines.say: [smug] Fifty teef for da buggy. Dat's da price.
lines.text: FIFTY TEEF FOR DA BUGGY. DAT'S DA PRICE.

lines.say: [flat] Ork teef keep growing. Fight more, get richer.
lines.text: ORK TEEF KEEP GROWING. FIGHT MORE, GET RICHER.

lines.say: [amazed] So their bank is... a brawl?
lines.text: SO THEIR BANK IS... A BRAWL?

lines.say: [dry] The richest Orks are the Flash Gitz. Loudest guns, biggest brawls.
lines.text: THE RICHEST ORKS ARE THE FLASH GITZ. LOUDEST GUNS, BIGGEST BRAWLS.

lines.say: [grinning, loud] Oi, squishy! Nice teef! Wot'll ya take for 'em?
lines.text: OI, SQUISHY! NICE TEEF! WOT'LL YA TAKE FOR 'EM?

lines.say: [lisping, dazed] Why did da Ork pay wib MY teef?!
lines.text: WHY DID DA ORK PAY WIB MY TEEF?!

pistol: Heavy bolt pistol cocking click, metallic
boom: Big bolt pistol shot boom, echo
charge: Army of men and monsters charging, boots and roaring
cheer: Crowd of rowdy brutish monsters roaring
page: Comic book page turning quickly, paper whoosh
whoosh: Quick soft camera whoosh swipe transition
puff: Man exhales a long puff of cigar smoke, slow breath
wind: Strong gust of wind blast, flapping cloth
crack: Heavy punch to the jaw, crunch and teeth rattling
coins: Handful of small teeth poured into a metal bucket, rattling

music: Tense grimdark war drums, low brass, building to a heroic charge, then a dry sombre cello ending, instrumental, no vocals, 110 bpm
